reviews.title: Fix the onboarding/signup process..
reviews.text: Based on what I’ve seen in the screenshots of this app and the overall UI, it looks like a nice concept and could help out a lot of people abstain from corn. That being said, I absolutely despise the way this app is set up- requiring payment to do literally anything on the app. You need to change this and provide ‘some’ features to users before they’re forced to hand over money without knowledge of the app. You could help out so many more people by doing this, and if they find the user experience effective and want more, they’ll pay for the additional features. It’s a win-win for both parties.

reviews.title: Have to spend money to better yourself
reviews.text: I downloaded this app because I genuinely wanted help resisting urges, but I couldn’t even use it without being forced into a paid subscription after signing in. It’s disappointing to market an app as support for people who are struggling, only to put the main features behind a paywall. I understand developers need to make money, but there should at least be a meaningful free version so people can see if the app actually helps before paying. I ended up uninstalling it because it felt misleading and frustrating.

reviews.title: Feels like a scam!
reviews.text:
Yeah, this app is very odd. And I wouldn’t trust this on your device. In the beginning, I was impressed until I realized it doesn’t properly track your streak due to resetting when you simply click a different tab. 

They force you to pay, no trials or free version available. They have hidden subscription options wayyyy cheaper than what’s initially offered through the app. Their “AI” assistant times out. Even with simplistic sentences. 

They have a customer support button that leads nowhere! Their Discord doesn’t seem like it is moderated at all. Such a terrible experience

DO NOT BUY THIS! I use the word buy because this app is not free. If you’re looking for a decent app for you to conquer your addiction use No Nut. It helped me stay sober for a year, but I wanted to try something new and the reviews raved about it.

reviews.title: Polished presentation, good mission, pretty buggy
reviews.text:
Pretty much what the title says, I signed up for seed pro ($12 a month) and tried to get the app set up. It has a lot of polish and a lot of promise but really I’m not very sure of how good the support structure is. Even after purchasing pro many of the features are still soft locked to me because of the amount of bugs this app has. Cant even get to the support page for the same reason- when clicking a lot of options the app remains unresponsive. Even in the setup I had to restart multiple times. 

I like the idea, I like the look and feel of the app but its still got a lot of kinks to work out and I think it needs a lot more in terms of the support structure. All I know is how many people failed/succeeded day-day and the ability to journal.

Gonna keep with it for a bit but not sure how long
